text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
That wraps up today's training, then.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
You're really putting in the effort.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Good work today.
You heading home now?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
The race with Orfe-san is coming up soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, there's still a lot I fall short on, but... Even so, I wanna do everything I possibly can!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't wanna bring any regrets
into a match against my rival...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
May I run for just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I want to do everything I can, too.
Every single means possible, all to seize victory.
choice_data_list: Let's stop here for today, or you'll overwork yourself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Well then, I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to fall behind either...!
Not to Shion-san, and not to 'her'—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I persuaded her that adequate rest is essential to deliver peak performance.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is true.
Perhaps I was rushing things a bit...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll rest up for today.
I'll give it my all again starting tomorrow—!
